pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal dark brown regions with irregular, high-contrast boundaries. Spatial area is greatest on the mid-flank, with patches appearing more elongated and angular near the neck base. Edges show small-scale pixel-level undulations.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space with a mean thickness of approximately 5-8% of patch width. Junctions are primarily triadic nodes. Continuity is maintained throughout the visible mid-section of the torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the visible lower-neck and shoulder ridge, consisting of discrete vertical hair filaments against the sky background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several faint, horizontal linear striations across the mid-to-posterior flank, appearing as darker, narrow interruptions within the light-colored corridor pathways.
